cohort: 194 patients staying at the Obstetrics and New-borns Department of the Duchess Anna Mazowiecka Clinical Hospital in Warsaw from September until December 2018
finding: Feeding with infant formula is more frequent after caesarean section and when there is coexistence of diseases with pregnancy, and suckling the breast during the first skin-to-skin contact has a positive effect on the duration of lactation.
mod_finding: Infant formula feeding is more frequent after caesarean section.
